summary: 针对 Binance 事件中被保存后回放的 7702 授权，EIP-8477 提议让每个授权绑定最近 256 个区块之一，过期作废。Frame Transaction 有两处修订：lightclient 加入 lean SPHINCS 后量子签名，nerolation 提议签名的 calldata 成本不计入 MAX_VERIFY_GAS。一批非作者 PR 集中修正 EIP-2780、EIP-8037、EIP-8038 等 Glamsterdam 规范文字。L2BEAT 更名为 ETHBEAT。

items.topic: EIP-8477：带新鲜度的 7702 委托授权
items.title: EIP-8477 Recent Block Bound Delegation Authorizations 讨论帖
items.note: 00:39 开帖（作者 dangerousfood），动机直接写的是 Binance 事件中的 7702 清扫。每个授权除了链 ID、委托地址和 nonce，还要签入一个最近的执行区块号和区块头哈希。被包含进区块 N 时，签入的区块必须是 N 之前 256 个祖先之一且哈希匹配；正好 256 个区块前仍有效，257 个就失效，当前和未来区块都不行。新鲜度在签名恢复之前检查，过期或不匹配的授权直接跳过。
items.title_en: EIP-8477 Recent Block Bound Delegation Authorizations discussion thread
items.note_en: Opened at 00:39 by dangerousfood, names the 7702 sweeps in the Binance incident as its motivation. In addition to chain ID, delegate address and nonce, every authorization also signs a recent execution block number and block header hash. When included in block N, the signed block must be one of the 256 ancestors before N with a matching hash. Exactly 256 blocks back is still valid, 257 is not, and neither the current block nor future blocks count. Freshness is checked before signature recovery, and stale or mismatched authorizations are simply skipped.

items.title: EIPs PR #12617：EIP-8141 不把 calldata 成本算进 MAX_VERIFY_GAS
items.note: 15:59 由 nerolation 提交。内存池规则 6 原文“验证 `tx.signatures` 的固有成本”可能被理解为包含签名字节的 calldata 成本。修订改为 `signature_verification_cost`，并写明 `frame_data_cost`、`signature_data_cost` 不计入。理由：MAX_VERIFY_GAS 限制的是节点验证工作量，calldata 成本付的是带宽和区块空间；如果计入，PQ 签名光凭体积就会超过 10 万的上限。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12617: EIP-8141 leaves calldata cost out of MAX_VERIFY_GAS
items.note_en: Opened at 15:59 by nerolation. Mempool rule 6 originally said "the intrinsic cost of verifying `tx.signatures`", which could be read as including the calldata cost of the signature bytes. The revision changes it to `signature_verification_cost` and states that `frame_data_cost` and `signature_data_cost` are not counted. The reasoning: MAX_VERIFY_GAS limits the validation work a node does, while calldata cost pays for bandwidth and block space. If calldata were counted, a PQ signature would exceed the 100,000 limit on size alone.

image.credit_en: Ethereum Magicians, EIP-8477: Recent Block Bound Delegation Authorizations

summary_en: Responding to the 7702 authorizations that were stored and replayed in the Binance incident, EIP-8477 proposes binding every authorization to one of the last 256 blocks so that it expires. Frame Transaction got two revisions: lightclient added lean SPHINCS post-quantum signatures, and nerolation proposed leaving the calldata cost of signatures out of MAX_VERIFY_GAS. A batch of non-author PRs corrected the wording of EIP-2780, EIP-8037, EIP-8038 and other Glamsterdam specs. L2BEAT was renamed ETHBEAT.
